name: Alt.
source:
A night town where "red night kidnappers" abound.　
This is the story of a single night in which the main character, running away from something, becomes a model for a painter who says he will shelter him.
translation:
夜晚的小镇上，“红夜拐子”四处出没。
主人公正躲避着什么。一位画家说愿意收留他，他便做了画家的模特。这个故事就发生在那一夜。
